title: It Does The Job But It Feels Flimsy And Cheap
text: It Does The Job But It Feels Flimsy And Cheap. The top of my microwave does tend to get dusty so this dustproof cover is a nice idea. It seems like it will do the job and it looks okay on the microwave. The fabric feels thin though and there are threads hanging off the edges. It does not feel like high quality material. Given the price though and the fact that once you put it on the microwave you probably won't be interacting with it much after that, the cheap feel may not be a big deal. One thing does confuse me a bit though. That's the thin pockets on each side of the cover. I'm not sure what I would use them for as the only written material I keep in the kitchen are cookbooks and those pockets are too small for any of the ones I have. Still, this cover serves a function and the price is reasonable for what you get, so I do have to give this product a three star rating.
